review.scope: Production Python, Lua and browser-script files changed from main under fort_gym, scripts, hook and web; artifact directories excluded.
conclusions: Keyboard-only and selected-workshop conditions keep distinct schemas, prompt profiles and pinned binding identities; historical controls cannot silently dispatch a workshop shortcut.

The workshop helper requires a selected completed workshop, uses native job definitions and ordinary labor/material processing, and reports queue insertion rather than completed production. Partial or unknown mutation is not retried.

The empty-key native probe always records and validates a paused boundary with a nonempty save name before a successful return; the workshop executor's boundary lookup is supported by its caller contract.

V2 continuation limits bind to the exact parent checkpoint, preserve original configuration and memory/usage history, and append explicit increases once. Offline planning is not spending or execution authority.
Per-window recording export verifies internal segment lineage and binds the next window to its first segment, preserving cumulative saved state without counting inherited frames twice.
The fixed endurance coordinator verifies retained operators, runtime source and settled owner receipts, audits each window, and stops at the declared decision ceiling without a new window.
Public action projection excludes private memory. Live choice, verified recorded execution, queued work, completed production and qualified saved outcomes remain distinct.

The descriptive comparison retains missing values, infrastructure failures, unknown subscription charges, single-seed limits and the explicitly declared storage amendment; it does not create a ranking.
limitations: This is implementer review with focused offline regression tests, not independent approval or new native gameplay acceptance.

Supporting HTML, CSS, configurations, fixtures and versioned evidence are covered by the prior source-pinned integration/publication records; the 149 count is not an inventory of every repository file.

The historical global static-analysis baseline remains nine Ruff findings and 465 mypy errors in 27 files. That baseline was not rerun here; only the changed Python review scope passed Ruff. No Black check is claimed.
No additional browser visual review, website deployment or service identity inspection was performed in this source-only review.

scoped_ruff.scope: All Python files among the 37 newer reviewed production versions

delivery.remaining_requirement: Owner-authorized promotion of the reviewed combined source to main. All eleven open stack heads are ancestors of this candidate; no stack retarget or main merge was performed.
